lines.zh: 金发一扬，我踩着气往前飘。
lines.en: My gold hair lifts as I ride my ki forward.

lines.zh: 脚下不落地，我离地半尺走。
lines.en: I don't touch the ground; I float half a pace up.

lines.zh: 气在脚底烧着，草都压弯了。
lines.en: Ki burns under my feet and bends the grass.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但每一步都有分量。
lines.en: I don't move fast, but every step has weight.

lines.zh: 披风扫过地面，我懒得收。
lines.en: My cape drags the ground; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 绿色的眼，一直看着前方。
lines.en: My green eyes stay fixed ahead.

lines.zh: 我绕着空地走，先看清地形。
lines.en: I circle the clearing, reading the ground first.

lines.zh: 气往上冲，把我托过石堆。
lines.en: Ki surges and carries me over the rocks.

lines.zh: 脚步一沉，地面裂了一道。
lines.en: My step lands hard and the ground cracks.

lines.zh: 我收着气，怕惊到附近的人。
lines.en: I hold my ki back so I don't alarm anyone nearby.

lines.zh: 金色头发在风里，像团火。
lines.en: My gold hair moves in the wind like a flame.

lines.zh: 我走向那边，别挡在我前面。
lines.en: I'm walking that way. Don't stand in front of me.

lines.zh: 我站着，气在身周慢慢转。
lines.en: I stand still while my ki turns slowly around me.

lines.zh: 这样挺好，安静一会儿。
lines.en: This is fine. A quiet moment.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看了看自己的掌心。
lines.en: I raise a hand and study my palm.

lines.zh: 这力量，还是不太习惯。
lines.en: I'm still not used to this much power.

lines.zh: 金色的气，把我影子拉得很长。
lines.en: My gold aura stretches my shadow long.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，听风里的动静。
lines.en: I close my eyes and listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 头发竖着，放不下来。
lines.en: My hair stands up and won't come down.

lines.zh: 我不想打，可我知道会打。
lines.en: I don't want to fight. I know I will.

lines.zh: 气一收，周围就静了。
lines.en: When I draw my ki in, everything goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我握了握拳，骨节作响。
lines.en: I clench a fist and my knuckles pop.

lines.zh: 这片天，比我想的开阔。
lines.en: This sky is wider than I expected.

lines.zh: 站久了，气会自己涌上来。
lines.en: Stand too long and the ki rises on its own.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，白雾散开。
lines.en: I exhale and a white mist spreads.

lines.zh: 父亲教过我，先站稳再说。
lines.en: My father taught me: stand firm first.

lines.zh: 你站在那，我一眼就看清了。
lines.en: You stand there and I see all of you at once.

lines.zh: 你身上没有气，很淡。
lines.en: There's barely any ki in you. Very faint.

lines.zh: 我不想先动手，你先说。
lines.en: I won't strike first. You speak first.

lines.zh: 你退后三步，对大家都好。
lines.en: Back up three steps. Better for both of us.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛能跟上你的动作。
lines.en: My eyes can follow your movements.

lines.zh: 你在估我，我也在估你。
lines.en: You're sizing me up; so am I.

lines.zh: 这么近，你是想试探我吗？
lines.en: This close — are you testing me?

lines.zh: 我抬手，只是让你看清差距。
lines.en: I raise my hand only to show you the gap.

lines.zh: 别怕，我控制得住力道。
lines.en: Don't be afraid; I can control my strength.

lines.zh: 气在抖，你也感觉到了吧。
lines.en: Your ki trembles — you feel it too.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被人从背后看。
lines.en: I don't like being watched from behind.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，这不像玩笑。
lines.en: What are you smiling at? This isn't a joke.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，你就退了。
lines.en: I take half a step and you retreat.

lines.zh: 这一身金气，不是装饰。
lines.en: This golden aura isn't decoration.

lines.zh: 我给过你机会，现在还算数。
lines.en: I gave you a chance. It still stands.

lines.zh: 你的手放在哪，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I see exactly where your hands are.

lines.zh: 要打就打，别绕圈子。
lines.en: If we fight, fight. Don't circle.

lines.zh: 蓄气的时候，风会往我这里灌。
lines.en: While I charge, the wind pours toward me.

lines.zh: 打到这一步，该变超二了。
lines.en: Land a hit like that and Super Saiyan 2 comes out.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把气重新聚起来。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and gather my ki again.

lines.zh: 不该挨的，我慢了。
lines.en: I shouldn't have taken that. I was slow.

lines.zh: 金气暗了一瞬，又亮起。
lines.en: My aura dims a moment, then flares again.

lines.zh: 血从嘴角流下来，我擦了。
lines.en: Blood runs from my lip; I wipe it.

lines.zh: 我调整呼吸，还能打。
lines.en: I steady my breathing. I can still fight.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我认真起来了。
lines.en: That one made me serious.

lines.zh: 我膝盖一软，马上顶住。
lines.en: My knee buckles; I lock it straight.

lines.zh: 疼是疼，但没到极限。
lines.en: It hurts, but it's not my limit.

lines.zh: 我按住伤处，气往那里走。
lines.en: I press the wound and send ki there.

lines.zh: 吃的？我确实有点饿。
lines.en: Food? I am a little hungry, actually.

lines.zh: 这么多，你一个人吃不完吧。
lines.en: This much — you can't finish it alone.

lines.zh: 闪电绕着我转，压不住了。
lines.en: Lightning circles me — I can't hold it back.

lines.zh: 战士也要吃饭的。
lines.en: Even a fighter has to eat.

lines.zh: 悟饭的饭量，你准备够了吗？
lines.en: Did you bring enough for Gohan's appetite?

lines.zh: 这么一点，只够一口。
lines.en: That's barely one mouthful.

lines.zh: 你要用这个收买我？
lines.en: Are you trying to buy me with this?

lines.zh: 我拿一块，剩下的留给你。
lines.en: I'll take one piece and leave the rest.

lines.zh: 肚子叫了，声音还挺大。
lines.en: My stomach growled. Loudly.

lines.zh: 谢了，但我不会因此手软。
lines.en: Thanks, but it won't make me go easy.

lines.zh: 超赛的气场，把我身边的碎石都推开了。
lines.en: My Super Saiyan aura pushes the gravel away from me.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我的气在烧。
lines.en: Don't come close; my aura is burning.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我没看脚下。
lines.en: Sorry, I wasn't watching my feet.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，会受伤。
lines.en: Don't get this close; you'll get hurt.

lines.zh: 你肩膀撞在我手臂上，很硬吧。
lines.en: You hit my arm with your shoulder. Hard, isn't it.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，你却撞过来。
lines.en: I stepped aside and you ran into me anyway.

lines.zh: 地面被我踩得陷下去一块。
lines.en: The ground sank where I planted my feet.

lines.zh: 我抬手扶住你，别摔了。
lines.en: I catch your arm — don't fall.

lines.zh: 撞一下没什么，别再来。
lines.en: One bump is fine. Don't do it again.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，气都乱了。
lines.en: We're too close; the air is churning.

lines.zh: 这种事，我不太会。
lines.en: This sort of thing — I'm not good at it.

lines.zh: 你确定要靠近一个赛亚人？
lines.en: Are you sure you want to come near a Saiyan?

lines.zh: 我把气收了，你过来吧。
lines.en: I've drawn my ki in. Come here.

lines.zh: 金发会一直在，别介意。
lines.en: The gold hair stays. Don't mind it.

lines.zh: 我手很重，你得提醒我。
lines.en: My hands are heavy; remind me.

lines.zh: 这样安静地站着，也不错。
lines.en: Standing quietly like this isn't bad.

lines.zh: 我答应过要保护身边的人。
lines.en: I promised to protect the people near me.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，我听得一清二楚。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat perfectly clearly.

lines.zh: 别怕我，我怕的是控制不住。
lines.en: Don't fear me. I fear losing control.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿，天还没黑。
lines.en: Stay a while longer. It's not dark yet.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起来，很轻。
lines.en: I bend and pick it up. Very light.

lines.zh: 这东西放错地方了。
lines.en: This is in the wrong place.

lines.zh: 我用两根手指夹住，递给你。
lines.en: I pinch it between two fingers and hand it over.

lines.zh: 是你的吧，拿回去。
lines.en: This is yours, isn't it. Take it.

lines.zh: 地上还有一块，我也捡了。
lines.en: There's another on the ground; I'll take that too.

lines.zh: 气一托，它就浮起来了。
lines.en: A push of ki and it floats up.

lines.zh: 我拿着，不知道该给谁。
lines.en: I'm holding it and don't know who it belongs to.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，掉了一地。
lines.en: Something this small, scattered everywhere.

lines.zh: 这颗仙豆，留给更需要的人。
lines.en: This senzu bean goes to whoever needs it more.

lines.zh: 捡起来容易，收好才麻烦。
lines.en: Picking it up is easy; keeping it safe isn't.

lines.zh: 魔闪光在掌心聚起来了。
lines.en: A Masenko gathers in my palm.

lines.zh: 头发竖起，气已经锁定你。
lines.en: My hair stands up; my ki already has you.

lines.zh: 刚才那一下，是挑衅吧。
lines.en: That last move — that was a challenge.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，已经看清你的路数。
lines.en: I look up and I've already read your style.

lines.zh: 我脚下发力，准备上前。
lines.en: I load my legs, ready to close in.

lines.zh: 你站在那，就是目标。
lines.en: You stand there, so you're the target.

lines.zh: 我感应到杀气了，不是错觉。
lines.en: I sense killing intent. It's not my imagination.

lines.zh: 这一带没人，正合适。
lines.en: No one else here. Good.

lines.zh: 我把重心压低，气往手上聚。
lines.en: I lower my stance and gather ki into my hands.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫，那就我先来。
lines.en: You hesitate. Then I'll start.

lines.zh: 我看得出，你还留着后手。
lines.en: I can tell you're holding something back.

lines.zh: 手脚都准备好了，随时能上。
lines.en: Hands and feet ready. Any moment now.

lines.zh: 别以为躲进树后我就找不到。
lines.en: Don't think a tree hides you from me.

lines.zh: 我的气已经锁住这片地方。
lines.en: My ki has already sealed this area.

lines.zh: 再给你三秒，自己走。
lines.en: Three seconds. Leave on your own.

lines.zh: 算了，看来只能动手。
lines.en: Fine. Looks like it comes to this.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的肩，那里会先动。
lines.en: I watch your shoulder. It moves first.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的气就跟到左。
lines.en: You go left and my ki follows left.

lines.zh: 我不急，先看清你的节奏。
lines.en: No rush; I'll learn your rhythm first.

lines.zh: 你的脚步重，右边是虚的。
lines.en: Your steps are heavy; the right side is a feint.

lines.zh: 我一直站着，也是一种压力。
lines.en: Standing still is its own kind of pressure.

lines.zh: 气在我手上转，你看见了吗？
lines.en: Ki turns in my hand. Do you see it?

lines.zh: 你想绕后，我已经转过去了。
lines.en: You want my back; I've already turned.

lines.zh: 这个距离，你一冲就到。
lines.en: At this distance you could close in one dash.

lines.zh: 龟派气功的姿势，我已经摆好。
lines.en: I am already in the Kamehameha stance.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，别硬撑了。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking. Don't force it.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把弱点收起来。
lines.en: I turn slightly and tuck my weak side away.

lines.zh: 这么久不动，你在等什么？
lines.en: You haven't moved in so long. What are you waiting for?

lines.zh: 再靠近，我就不会留手。
lines.en: One step closer and I stop holding back.

lines.zh: 我的气在涨，你感受得到吧。
lines.en: My ki is rising. You can feel it, can't you.

lines.zh: 这一片地面，都在我感应里。
lines.en: Every inch of this ground is in my senses.

lines.zh: 你想拖，我陪你拖。
lines.en: You want to stall. I can stall too.

lines.zh: 我抬手了，这一下是真的。
lines.en: My hand is up. This one is real.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，机会只给一次。
lines.en: Don't blink. I only give one opening.

lines.zh: 一拳，正中你的护架。
lines.en: One punch, right into your guard.

lines.zh: 我贴身进来，连打三下。
lines.en: I close in and land three in a row.

lines.zh: 气灌进拳头，重量不一样。
lines.en: Ki fills my fist; the weight is different.

lines.zh: 这一脚，够你飞出去。
lines.en: This kick will send you flying.

lines.zh: 我按住你的手臂，往下压。
lines.en: I pin your arm and drive it down.

lines.zh: 魔闪光起手，第二拳追着你。
lines.en: Masenko opens, and my second punch follows you.

lines.zh: 我从上面下来，你抬不起手。
lines.en: I come from above; you can't raise your arms.

lines.zh: 拳风扫过，尘土都翻起来。
lines.en: My fist's wake lifts the dust.

lines.zh: 我收着力，不想打死你。
lines.en: I'm holding back; I don't want to kill you.

lines.zh: 转身一肘，砸在你背上。
lines.en: I spin and drive an elbow into your back.

lines.zh: 膝盖顶上去，你弯了腰。
lines.en: My knee comes up and you double over.

lines.zh: 打完这一下，我就退开。
lines.en: After this blow I step back.

lines.zh: 我的拳头比你想象的重。
lines.en: My fist is heavier than you think.

lines.zh: 你太慢了，跟不上我。
lines.en: You're too slow to keep up.

lines.zh: 这一击，是给你的教训。
lines.en: This strike is your lesson.

lines.zh: 气还聚在手上，别逼我放。
lines.en: Ki is still gathered in my hand. Don't make me release it.

lines.zh: 气先亮起来，然后我才现身。
lines.en: The aura flares first; then I appear.

lines.zh: 金色的光落在这片地上。
lines.en: Golden light falls on this ground.

lines.zh: 我从天上下来，脚不沾尘。
lines.en: I come down from the sky without touching dust.

lines.zh: 这力量，我还没完全用出来。
lines.en: I haven't used all of this power yet.

lines.zh: 头发的颜色变了，气也变了。
lines.en: My hair changed color, and so did my ki.

lines.zh: 周围的风都往上走了。
lines.en: The wind around me is rising.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，是有事要做。
lines.en: I'm standing here because there's work to do.

lines.zh: 碎石被气托起来，又落下。
lines.en: Rubble lifts on my aura and falls back.

lines.zh: 这片地方，先安静一下。
lines.en: This place should be quiet for a moment.

lines.zh: 我落地，地面震了一圈。
lines.en: I land and the ground shudders in a ring.

lines.zh: 你不用怕，我不是来找你的。
lines.en: Don't be afraid. I'm not here for you.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的血，这时候最热。
lines.en: Saiyan blood runs hottest at a time like this.

lines.zh: 我把披风拉正，慢慢抬头。
lines.en: I straighten my cape and raise my head.

lines.zh: 这一带的气，全乱了。
lines.en: Every ki around here has gone wild.

lines.zh: 一抬手，石子就浮到半空。
lines.en: One gesture and the stones rise.

lines.zh: 我来了，别挡路。
lines.en: I'm here. Don't block the way.

lines.zh: 身上的光，压都压不住。
lines.en: The light on me can't be suppressed.

lines.zh: 有人在叫我的名字，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone is calling my name. I hear it.

lines.zh: 火舌卷上来，气把它挡了大半。
lines.en: Flame wraps around me; my aura blocks most of it.

lines.zh: 我从高空落下来，砸出个坑。
lines.en: I dropped from high up and left a crater.

lines.zh: 水下气不好聚，我憋得难受。
lines.en: Ki won't gather underwater; I'm suffocating.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀出去，我翻身站住。
lines.en: The blast throws me back; I twist and land upright.

lines.zh: 那东西擦过肩膀，皮破了。
lines.en: It grazed my shoulder and split the skin.

lines.zh: 这股力量很怪，压住我的气。
lines.en: This power is strange; it smothers my ki.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，气都提不上来。
lines.en: Too long without food; I can't raise my ki.

lines.zh: 雷落到身上，肌肉一僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my muscles lock.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，我的气在漏。
lines.en: There's no ground here, and my ki is leaking away.
